core_requests: P331 spec compiler: a placeholder that extracts a handle from a URL entity (has_account pivots), safe-XML schema checks, per-spec state hooks (cooldown/backoff) and a key-dependent second request, so the P116 platforms (community_profiles.PLATFORM_SPECS) can be recompiled as declarative specs.

ScopedHttp API that lets a module trip the core host circuit for a wall it detects itself (e.g. TikTok empty hydration past the 64 KB marker window); tiktok_public keeps an interim module-level per-run table.
Per-source allowed licence bases in the provider registry (e.g. tiktok.profile_page: provider_grant only) enforced by policy.decide; tiktok_public enforces it in-module today.
Alias env V3LUM_GITHUB_TOKEN on key 'github' in v3lum/data/providers/github.json (owned by the github provider fragment owner).
Per-plan (keyless vs keyed) quota blocks in provider fragments: Stack Exchange is 300/day per IP keyless and 10,000/day per key; the stackexchange block keeps a third of the keyless figure.
A {url}-style placeholder for URL entities in Module.manual_link so the engine renders manual links for URL-accepting modules (the P116/P118 modules add the profile URL via res.link themselves).
An app credential pair (client id + secret) per provider or a core app-token helper (client_credentials POST) so Twitch Helix (P116 FC1) can ship.
Case-subject marking (subject roles) readable by modules, so git_metadata_identity (P115 FC2) can run on pivots the analyst promotes to subjects, not only on typed seeds.
A per-case content toggle (with purpose) the P116 modules can read to show bios/locations/real names that mention no case entity (P116 FC8).
notes: P115 git_metadata_identity: API-only (no git binary/clone, FC1/FC6 clone helper backlogged), runs only on analyst-typed seeds with a recorded purpose, <=10 own non-fork repos, counts not lists for non-tied identities, all pivots PROBABLE expand=False; fixtures doc-shaped because the research egress proxy refuses api.github.com (backlog). P116 community_profiles_pack: built as one module per platform (steam_community_profile, chesscom_player, lichess_user, medium_feed, snapchat_profile, disqus_profile, mojang_profile, pinterest_profile, stackexchange_user) in community_profiles.py with a declarative PLATFORM_SPECS table and lint_pack_specs (FC2: Duolingo refused by construction, permanent council decision); Twitch Helix deferred to backlog (no found/absent fixtures; needs client id + secret app token). Snapchat and Disqus are terms 'unknown' (disabled in every profile). Content (bio/location/posts) shown only when it mentions a case entity or the organisation brand/domain, otherwise content_withheld. P118 tiktok_public: never sends a request without a provider_grant licence_allow entry (terms 'license'); always emits the manual link; one GET, retries 0, min_interval 5 s, FC5 fields only, P314 id timestamp decode, challenge/empty hydration = BLOCKED + per-run circuit, unknown statusCode/layout = ERROR, never EMPTY. Provider fragments created for null-owned hosts: valve, chesscom, lichess, medium, snap, disqus, mojang, pinterest, stackexchange, tiktok; github extension github__p3-G05-2.json adds source git_metadata_identity_commits. No datasets, pivot packs or correlation rules. Backlog: docs/backlog/p3-G05-2.md.
